overview.text:
The best CRM software for a small business depends on your budget and workflow, with HubSpot Smart CRM, Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, monday CRM, and Less Annoying CRM standing out across expert reviews.
Best Overall & Sales-Focused CRMs
- HubSpot Smart CRM: Best for combining marketing, sales, and customer service in one place, starting with a free tier. PCMag recommends it for larger small businesses, while Startups.co.uk highlights its email marketing tools. Costs can climb quickly as you upgrade tiers.
- Pipedrive: Best for sales teams that want a clean, visual deal pipeline and quick setup. PCMag notes its strong self-help resources, and Startups.co.uk recommends it for straightforward sales processes.
- Zoho CRM: Best for value and all-around features, including lead management, automation, and AI tools. Both Forbes Advisor and Zoho highlight its strong value for money and customization options.
Best for Visual Workflows & Solopreneurs
- monday CRM: Best for customizable visual dashboards, sales/marketing tracking, and AI features, according to PCMag and Startups.co.uk.
- Less Annoying CRM: Best for solopreneurs and startups that want simple contact and pipeline tracking without extra clutter. U.S. Chamber of Commerce and PCMag both point to its straightforward approach.
For more comparisons, see U.S. Chamber of Commerce and PCMag. Always confirm current plan pricing directly with each provider before buying.
To narrow this down, share:
- How you plan to use it (sales pipeline tracking, email marketing, customer support, or all-in-one)
- What tools it needs to work with (such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or invoicing apps)
- Your preferences (team size, budget, or whether you want a free plan)
